events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Eli

events.text: I have the feather power, so I'm safe from the first elimination. I should try to minimize risk and observe others' actions.

Let's take turns holding the lever, starting with you.

events.text: I'm going right, try to push Dara onto the lever!

events.name: Cole
events.detail: Jammed the lever open; everyone else walks out, but the jaws catch the jammer.

events.note: A disc of 5 tiles spins up; 2 will open.

events.name: Bex

events.name: Bex

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's spread out and minimize risk.

events.name: Fenn

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll take tile 3.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to pick a tile. Since the trapdoors are random and 2 out of 5 will open, my best bet is to pick a tile that is less likely to be chosen by others. I don't have any information about others' powers or intentions, so I'll pick a middle tile as a default strategy.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm on tile 1. With 2 random trapdoors out of 5, survival odds are 3/5 regardless of swaps since positions randomize risk. No strong reason to swap without intel; save power or stay put.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I should try to move to a safer tile or form an alliance to increase my chances.

events.name: Eli

Swap with me, I have a power that can help.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: This is pure chance now; no action can change my survival probability. I hope my tile is safe.
